header.superHtml:
Proper handwashing before and after brushing and flossing is essential for overall hygiene and health. However, many commercial soaps contain harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances that can be harmful to children. SuperMouth’s Collectible Scented Hand Soaps offer a safe, naturally-derived alternative, protecting your family’s health while making hygiene engaging.

  • Collectible SuperMouth Characters: Each soap reveals one of nine exciting SuperMouth superheroes or villains, turning handwashing into a playful adventure.

  • Delightful Mild Vanilla Scent: Gentle fragrance kids love, encouraging frequent handwashing.

  • Safe, Naturally Derived Ingredients: Ranked #1 by the Environmental Working Group (EWG), crafted without harsh chemicals or artificial additives for maximum safety.

  • Promotes Healthy Habits: Regular use encourages frequent handwashing, seamlessly fitting into your child’s daily hygiene and oral care routines.

  • Mess-Free and Long-Lasting: Designed for easy handling, these soaps stay clean and dry between uses, reducing mess and waste.

  • Inspired by Toothstar: Superhero-themed designs connect handwashing with the engaging SuperMouth universe, promoting consistent hand hygiene in a kid-friendly way.

  • Ideal Companion: Pair with the Soap-a-Hero Handwashing Station to further encourage good hygiene practices, making cleanliness fun for kids.


Tip: These collectible soaps aren’t just for hands—or even just for kids! The whole family can enjoy them as a fun and effective total body wash.


Recommended for ages 4+ years.

FAQs
items.html:
What age group are the collectible soaps suitable for?
SuperMouth’s collectible soaps are recommended for children ages 4 and up, but they’re safe and enjoyable for the entire family.
How many collectible characters are there?
There are nine unique collectible SuperMouth Squad superheroes and villains hidden within our soaps.
Are these soaps safe for sensitive skin?
Yes, our soaps are made from naturally-derived ingredients rated #1 by EWG, ensuring they’re gentle and safe even for sensitive skin.
Can these soaps be used as body washes too?
Absolutely! They’re versatile enough to be used as a gentle, effective total body wash for kids and adults alike.

reviews.name: Monserrat
reviews.title: Fun idea for kids
reviews.body: I think it’s such a cute and clever idea to have a little character inside the hand soap! It makes washing hands more fun and gives kids an extra reason to want to wash their hands. I thought it was such a creative idea for my daughter, and she absolutely loves it!

reviews.name: Tami
reviews.title: So clever, tooth shaped soap!
reviews.body: As a dental professional of 40 years, I could not be more pleased with a tooth shaped soap and a superhero inside! My six-year-old granddaughter now loves washing her hands!!! we plan on collecting all the soaps. The scent is mild, it says nicely, soap turns even more clear, revealing a clear image of the superhero inside. Highly recommend!
